errors.text: The hypothesis places the critical LCO network within the B2 phase, whereas the target mechanism centers on enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains approaching Ni3Al stoichiometry.
It omits the formation of jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries and the associated stress concentration and crack initiation at boundary tips.
The proposed 400–600 °C embrittlement interval does not reconstruct the approximately 550–750 °C brittle window, with peak embrittlement near 600 °C and recovery near 750 °C.
The cited evidence does not establish the requested ordered-domain dislocation mechanism involving increased APB energy and modulus, restricted cross-slip, and planar slip.

The proposed falsification experiment does not directly test the grain-boundary alternative through impurity-segregation measurements while localizing pile-ups and crack initiation at jagged phase-boundary tips.
